criteria.looked: What the AI looked at: the file and folder names in your chosen folders, how many files of each type, and when the files last changed. It does not open any file.
criteria.keep: What it keeps: documents you wrote, received or collected (reports, notes, contracts, papers, course material) and folders named for a project, a person or a date.
criteria.leave: What it leaves out: logs a program made as a by-product, files apps download or export (messengers and the like), caches, temp and crash files, build or generated output, installers and app backups, and folders where many similar-named files piled up at once.
criteria.code: Code repositories are always left out, even ones you wrote yourself: folders that are mostly source files and have a manifest such as package.json.
criteria.doubt: When in doubt it keeps the folder. Wrongly leaving out your own document makes it vanish from search, while including some clutter only costs time.
criteria.you: You decide. Hover an item to see the reason, undo it with the x, or add your own. The AI may judge a little differently each time.

embedding.title: Document Understanding Model
embedding.hint: Analyzes the meaning of documents. If you pick this computer, documents are not sent anywhere for embedding.
embedding.body: Choose where the embedding model that analyzes document meaning runs. The model is fixed to Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B, and any choice that sends document text off this computer needs your consent.
embedding.dimensionFixed: Model: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B (1024 dimensions). The model cannot be changed.
embedding.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the stored key
embedding.apiKeyHint: The key is stored in this Mac's secure keychain and never written to the config file.
embedding.consentRemote: I agree that document text is sent to a server off this computer
embedding.signInNote: The Dazzi cloud needs a Dazzi account sign-in. Sign in from the account settings first.
embedding.apiKeyHintPc: The key is stored in this PC's secure credential store and never written to the config file.

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.desc: Connect Dazzi to other agents, and connect external MCP servers to Dazzi.
mcp.listDesc: Servers connect when a search or chat starts. Changes apply from the next search.

exposureHint.codemode: The model calls the tools from a short script (default).
exposureHint.deferred: Only tools found with tool_search are offered to the model.
exposureHint.direct: Every tool is offered to the model like a built-in tool.

mcp.trust: An MCP server runs commands on this computer or connects to an outside service. Add only servers you trust. What a server returns is treated as data, never as instructions.
mcp.fileError: The MCP config file cannot be read, so nothing will be changed. Fix the file and reopen this page.

modal.name: Name
modal.envHint: Values may reference environment variables as ${NAME}.
modal.description: Description (so the model knows when to use it)
modal.advanced: This entry has settings the app does not edit; they are kept as they are.
modal.removeBody: The server is deleted from the config file. Data the server stored is left alone.

connect.title: Connect other agents
connect.desc: Let agents such as Claude Code and Codex search the documents Dazzi has indexed. Copy what's below and paste it into the agent.
connect.unavailable: Dazzi's MCP server can't be started on this computer, so there is nothing to copy.

hint.terminal: Paste it into a terminal and run it to register Dazzi with the agent.
hint.json: Add it to the agent's MCP config file (mcpServers), the format Cursor, Claude Desktop and others use.
hint.manual: For an agent not listed above, copy the values one by one into its add-MCP-server screen.

connect.readOnlyHint: Hides the index-refresh and report-saving tools so the agent can only search.

indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.desc: Check that your search folders and connected apps are up to date, and re-fetch only what changed.
indexing.empty: No data sources connected. Add one from Connected Apps.
indexing.footer: Only changed files and messages are re-read. An app connected for the first time is fully fetched.
indexing.localRefreshHint: Re-read documents in the search folders to update the search index. Only changed documents are processed.
indexing.scheduleUnsupported: This computer does not support automatic refresh while the app is closed.
indexing.scheduleNotRegistered: Automatic refresh is not registered yet. Pick the interval again to register it.
indexing.scheduleConflicts: This computer already has a scheduled task that refreshes Dazzi separately ({{list}}). To avoid processing the same folders twice, we recommend using only one.
indexing.scheduleActive: Even when the app is closed, it checks every {{minutes}} min and refreshes only the items that are due.

apps.title: Connected apps
apps.desc: Search your messengers, mail, and cloud content together in Dazzi.
apps.empty: No apps connected. Add one below.
apps.promptDesc: Choose a connection id and add it. Leave empty to use the template name.

sourceDetail.fallbackSummary: Manage the settings for this connection.
sourceDetail.enabledHint: Turn off to temporarily exclude this connection from search.
sourceDetail.appHintMissing: To fetch {{name}} content, the {{name}} app must be on this Mac.

sourceDetail.appHintMissingPc: To fetch {{name}} content, the {{name}} app must be installed on this computer.
sourceDetail.appHintInstalledPc: Content is fetched from the {{name}} app on this computer.

sourceDetail.descHint: Note when this connection is worth consulting.
sourceDetail.removeHint: Removed only from Dazzi search; the source app's data is not deleted.

sourceDetail.kakaoOnlyNote: KakaoTalk is read through lazykatok, which only works with the Mac app, so this connection is inactive on this computer.

scope.title: Search scope
scope.desc: Choose the folders Dazzi reads and searches, and what to exclude.
scope.foldersDesc: The contents of these folders are included in AI search.
scope.folderHint: Add or remove folders by entering their paths directly.
scope.emptyFolderNote: No search folders yet. Without any, the default search scope is used.
scope.excludeDesc: Folders and files that will not be searched.
scope.excludeNote: Developer folders ({{folders}}) and all folders starting with a dot (.idea, .vscode, .cache, etc.) are excluded automatically.
scope.excludeListHint: Also exclude folders and files with matching names.
scope.autoWatchHintOff: Unavailable because file search is off.
scope.autoWatchHintOn: Updates the file-name search list when files change. The document content index is refreshed manually from the Indexing screen.
scope.addFolderDesc: Enter the folder path to include in search.
scope.addItemDesc: Enter the folder or file name to exclude from search.

web.title: Web search
web.desc: Uses internet search results in answers for questions that need up-to-date information.
web.useHint: Your question may be sent to the search service.
web.providerHintOff: Turn on web search to choose.
web.fetchHintOn: Uses the body text of search-result links in answers.

reading.title: Document reading
reading.desc: Set the preferred languages for reading and searching documents.
reading.sectionDesc: The preferred languages for reading and searching document content.
reading.langHint: You can select more than one.

duplicates.desc: Cleans up so the same content does not repeat in search results.

duplicates.versionsHint: Groups related files like report_final and report_final2 together.
duplicates.intervalHint: How often to re-check for file changes.
